text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are complete. We can begin 
the interview rehearsal whenever you're 
ready.
choice_data_list: I'm ready too. Shall we get started?
I'm ready too. Shall we begin?

text_block_list.text:
Holding the stack of papers that was on 
the desk, I face Air Messiah.

A few days ago, as an Umamusume currently 
drawing attention, Air Messiah received a 
request for a magazine interview.

So, per Air Messiah's request, we compiled 
a list of questions based on past articles 
and held a rehearsal.
choice_data_list:
First, please give us a brief 
self-introduction.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My name is Air Messiah. Inspired by 
my mother, who was a racing Umamusume, I 
set my sights on racing, and I am 
currently enrolled at Tracen Academy.
choice_data_list:
Thank you. Now then, what would you say 
your strengths are?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It's the steadiness to keep working 
diligently, no matter how mundane the 
task. I consider never cutting corners to 
be my strength.
choice_data_list:
What kind of Umamusume do people around 
you say you are?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: People say I'm a serious Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“—And those are my thoughts and 
aspirations heading into the next race.”

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
choice_data_list:
This feels less like an interview and more 
like a job screening...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That's... Now that you mention it, that is 
true...

The two of them quickly hold a debriefing 
session to exchange feedback. In the end, 
they concluded they had been overly 
businesslike in their eagerness to get 
things done right.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps my response was not the best, 
either. Next time, I shall try to expand 
on the topic and reply with a bit more 
emotion.
choice_data_list: I'll try being a bit more casual, too.

I think I'll try to be a little more 
casual too.

text_block_list.text:
Taking a deep breath together, we reset 
our minds with some facial muscle massages 
and vocal warm-ups.

"Once both had natural smiles on their 
faces, they resumed the rehearsal."
choice_data_list:
Your racing outfit—the blue and yellow are 
so striking!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you noticed. These are the colors 
of my mother's racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I decided when I was little that if I ever 
wore a racing silk, I would incorporate 
blue and yellow.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My own respect for my mother, and her 
wishes cheering me on—I want to run 
carrying both with me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In the eyes of the public, my mother might 
just be an 'unfortunate Umamusume' who 
racked up near-misses.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"However, my mother was undoubtedly strong 
and worthy of respect. I am proud of her. 
From the bottom of my heart."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I want to win— To 
win, and prove that my mother and I are 
strong."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I want to prove with my own body that my 
mother's running was not merely 'a close 
loss,' but a step toward seizing victory 
across generations.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
These colors given to me by my mother are 
imbued with such feelings.

While keeping it sincere, she honestly 
conveyed her feelings for her mother, 
leaving a very positive impression. Let's 
continue the rehearsal at this pace.
choice_data_list:
Are there any other details you were 
particular about with your racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Perhaps the flower around the 
neck?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"This is a flower I designed myself by 
crossbreeding bellflowers and watercress."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The language of flowers for bellflowers is 
'unchanging love' and 'sincerity.' And for 
watercress, it's 'indomitable strength,' 
'stability,' 'steadiness,' and 
'perseverance.'

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
They are all flowers I grew with my mother 
when I was a child, and I felt the 
meanings behind them were perfect for 
expressing my strengths...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To incorporate both, I designed it as an 
original flower.
choice_data_list: I see. An original is quite unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Surprising...! Fufu, if that is how it 
appeared to you, then my goal was 
achieved.

Even during the design phase, Air Messiah 
was determined to include this flower no 
matter what. When I asked if there was a 
meaning beyond flower language—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Incorporating original flowers is truly 
pushing the boundaries... Don't you think?

When she has that much confidence in a 
lovely white flower, it leaves me at a 
loss for words... Though I suppose this is 
very like Air Messiah.

With all the questions answered, the 
rehearsal came to an end. I commented that 
her responses were great, clearly 
conveying Air Messiah's sincerity and 
earnestness.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that puts me at ease. However, I'm 
sure it was not entirely flawless. If 
there is anything else of concern, please 
let me know.

Yeah... Without forgetting to smile like 
today.

Yeah... Never forgetting to smile, just 
like today.

you start.

text_block_list.text:
"I noticed she gets a deadpan expression 
when focusing too hard on an interview. I 
advised her to keep that in mind so she 
could show off Air Messiah's usual 
warmth."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
A smile, I see. Then, when practicing my 
responses, I shall look in the mirror and 
carefully check my expressions.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Every impression I make reflects upon my 
mother's reputation as well. I must apply 
myself diligently.

Eager to put it into practice right away, 
Air Messiah began checking her facial 
expression with a hand mirror. At this 
rate, she's sure to succeed in the real 
thing.

I've heard from Air Messiah that she used 
to be shy when she was little.

Even if she overcomes it through hard 
work, that doesn't mean she'll suddenly be 
comfortable in public. I told her not to 
forget to relax.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. They say deep breaths stimulate 
the parasympathetic nervous system, 
bringing peace to the mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I will regularly check that my breathing 
hasn't become shallow and make sure to 
take deep breaths. Thank you for the 
advice.

Air Messiah immediately pulled out her 
notepad and wrote down, "Be conscious of 
taking deep breaths."
